description_en: The watermark cannot be directly seen in the image, but it can be recovered from the image by using DecodeBlindWatermark
description_zh: 在图片中不能直接看到该水印，但可以通过DecodeBlindWatermark恢复图中隐藏的水印
name: EncodeBlindWatermark

parameters.help_en:
OSS URI of the image to which a blind watermark is to be added.

The OSS address follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS Bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
待添加盲水印图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: image_uri

parameters.help_en:
OSS address of the watermark image. The OSS address follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS Bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path.
The size of the watermark image should not exceed 2000 px.
At least one of the WatermarkUri and Content parameters must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
水印图片的OSS地址。OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一地域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径。
水印图片的大小建议不要超过2000 px。
参数WatermarkUri和参数Content必须至少设置一个
parameters.name: watermark_uri

parameters.help_en:
OSS URI where the image with the blind watermark added is saved.

The OSS address follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS Bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
添加盲水印后图片保存到的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: target_uri

parameters.help_en:
Quality of the output image. Default value: 90. Valid values: 70 to 100.

Higher quality results in a larger image size and better watermark parsing quality
parameters.help_zh:
输出图片的质量，默认值为90，取值范围为70~100。

质量越高，图片尺寸越大，水印解析质量越高
parameters.name: image_quality

parameters.help_en:
Text content to be used as the watermark, with a maximum of 100 bytes.

At least one of the WatermarkUri and Content parameters must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
作为水印的文字内容，最多100字节。

WatermarkUri参数和Content参数必须至少设置一个
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: Storage format of the watermarked image. Default value: jpg. Valid values: jpg and png
parameters.help_zh: 加水印后图片的存储格式，默认值为jpg，可选值包括jpg和png
parameters.name: target_image_type

parameters.help_en:
Watermark algorithm model. Default value: FFT. Valid values: FFT, FFT_FULL, DWT, and DWT_IBG. We recommend that you use DWT_IBG.

For differences between algorithm models, see Algorithm models
parameters.help_zh:
水印算法模型，默认值为FFT，可选值包括FFT、FFT_FULL、DWT和DWT_IBG，推荐您使用DWT_IBG。

不同算法模型的区别请参见算法模型
parameters.name: model

Content.description_en:
This parameter is returned only when the Content parameter is specified in the request.

Text content used as the watermark
Content.description_zh:
只有当请求中设置了Content参数时，才有显示此参数。

作为水印的文字内容

RequestId.description_en: The request ID of the current request

TargetUri.description_en: OSS URI where the watermarked image is saved
TargetUri.description_zh: 添加水印后图片保存到的OSS URI
